post_processing.summary: Converted flat green chroma-key background to alpha while preserving the original 1254x1254 transparent canvas. ImageMagick trim is intentionally skipped so transparent padding continues to preserve the source crop coordinate system.

ring.background_rendering: The product gallery uses CSS radial and linear gradients to reproduce the screenshot's beige card and warm bottom gradient separately from the transparent subject.

trim.reason: The transparent canvas preserves source crop placement information. Trimming would make the subject fill more of the image box and visually enlarge it unless trim offsets were recorded and compensated.

source_subject_visual_bbox.measurement: source screenshot threshold measurement inside crop 300x300+130+250

transparent_canvas_strategy.size_derivation: The previous 236px image box came from a stale tight-crop style bound. Because the current alpha PNG is untrimmed and its visible alpha bbox is only 780 / 1254 of the canvas width, rendering the full canvas at 236px made the visible subject about 147px wide. The corrected image box uses scaled source visible subject width 183px divided by 780/1254, yielding about 294px.
transparent_canvas_strategy.reason: The CSS placement uses the source subject visual bbox and current asset alpha bbox. This is not trim compensation; it is the required rendering rule for an untrimmed transparent canvas.

content_scroll_region.gap_preservation: The source chrome-to-gallery spacing is split between the persistent navigation's own 12px bottom safe padding and the scroll pane's 8px padding-top. This keeps the initial visual gap close to the screenshot while preventing scrolled content from visually attaching to the nav buttons.

implementation_notes: The screen root is constrained to 414px and uses fixed viewport-height flex ownership with overflow hidden so persistent chrome remains outside the scrollable content pane.
The top product navigation is page-level navigation, not content-local controls; it remains in the persistent chrome region with the status bar and owns internal safe padding around its buttons.

Gallery arrow and zoom controls are separate coded overlays, not baked into the product image asset. The transparent ring asset intentionally remains untrimmed; CSS sizing is derived from the source subject visual bbox and the asset alpha bbox so the visible ring, rather than the full transparent canvas, matches the screenshot.

The Ring Size horizontal option row uses full_bleed_scroll_with_inner_padding: the scroll strip has negative 17px inline margins and matching 17px internal padding/scroll-padding so the first chip aligns with the content column while overflow can continue to the screen edge.
The mobile page scroll owner and the Ring Size horizontal scroller hide browser scrollbars with cross-browser CSS while keeping vertical and horizontal scrolling enabled.

Fidelity-critical root, chrome, gallery, image, control, chip, price, section, and CTA styles are defined in src/pages/luxury-single/LuxurySinglePage.css with stable page-scoped selectors instead of relying on Tailwind arbitrary utilities. This keeps the reconstruction resilient when a dev preview has stale utility CSS or when critical arbitrary classes are not applied.
